text:
mira: kicking off micro-canary for lyra-lite-9b int6 in us-west — 5% traffic for 30m. goal: sensitivity slices + unit-price delta. pinging @devin for infra & @sam for evals :rocket:

devin: got it. scheduling on dedicated pool c3-gpu-2, canary id canary/lyra-lite-3277. will set autoscale min=2 max=6.

sam: running quick slices now. baseline (prod-13b-int8) avg latency 190ms p95 420ms cost/token $0.0009.

sam: lyra-lite-9b-int6 (canary warm) avg latency 140ms p95 360ms cost/token $0.00055 — rough numbers.

raj: product note — please monitor hallucination rate on KnowledgeQA slice (KQ-7). for that slice recall matters more than raw latency.

mira: noted. @sam can you run KQ-7 slice and compare recall/F1? also we need a one-slide scorecard for GTN with unit econ.

sam: quick run results:
```text
slice: KQ-7
prod-13b-int8: recall 0.82 f1 0.78
lyra-lite-9b-int6: recall 0.79 f1 0.75
delta_recall: -0.03
```

sam: unit-econ backtest (1M tokens): prod cost ~$900, lyra-lite ~$550 => savings ~$350 per M tokens (approx).

mira: tradeoff looks OK for chat tiers where recall drop <=3pts. propose routing rule: primary for conversational flows, force prod model for KQ-7 until recall validated. add canary flag for fallback.

devin: ops tweak: enable KV-cache priming and increase batch_size to 8 for the canary; should drop per-token GPU overhead. applying config now.

ops-bot: deploy canary/lyra-lite-3277 -> us-west (started) :gear:

sam: post-config quick numbers: latency down ~10%, cost/token down to ~$0.00048. KQ-7 recall unchanged at 0.79.

mira: thanks. I'll draft the scorecard for GTN: include latency avg/p95, cost/token, recall delta, recommended routing flag, rollback criteria (recall drop >5pts OR error rate >0.5%).

raj: LGTM. can we set a short GTN readout tomorrow 11am PT?

mira: yes — invite sent :calendar:

devin: canary finished initial window. ramping to 20% traffic as next step. ops-bot, please record metrics under /canaries/lyra-lite-3277.

ops-bot: metrics recording enabled -> /canaries/lyra-lite-3277 :white_check_mark:

mira: perfect. I'll attach the scorecard and routing patch to the ramp doc and flag to product. cheers team :tada:
